content.user_title: Build Modern React and Next.js Apps
content.value_statement: React and Next.js projects often need consistent setup choices across routing, components, styling, data, forms, tests, and deployment. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a phase-based workflow for planning and building modern frontend applications.
actual_capabilities: Guides project setup for React SPA and Next.js 14 App Router applications.
Breaks component architecture, state management, styling, data fetching, routing, forms, testing, and deployment into phases.
Lists related specialist skills to invoke for each development phase.
Provides copy-paste prompts for scaffolding, components, Tailwind CSS, Server Components, tests, and Vercel deployment.
Defines a modern stack covering TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, React Query, React Hook Form, Vitest, Playwright, and Vercel.
Includes quality gates for TypeScript, tests, linting, performance, accessibility, and responsive design.
limitations: Does not include executable project scaffolding scripts or generated source files.
Assumes the referenced companion skills are available in the user environment.
Does not replace framework documentation for version-specific API details.
Does not provide deployment credentials, CI configuration, or production infrastructure setup.

use_cases.title: Start a New Frontend Project
use_cases.description: Use the workflow to choose React or Next.js, configure TypeScript, and plan the initial project structure.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Full-Stack Next.js Delivery
use_cases.description: Use the phases to align routing, Server Components, API integration, forms, testing, and deployment work.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Implementation Steps
use_cases.description: Use the quality gates and phase checklist to review work before release.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a new Next.js 14 App Router project with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. List the setup decisions and first implementation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Component Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design the component hierarchy for my React application. Include layout components, reusable UI components, state boundaries, and custom hooks.

prompt_templates.title: Add Data, Forms, and Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan data fetching, API integration, forms, and validation for a Next.js feature. Include loading states, errors, and accessibility checks.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Testing and Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a release plan for a Next.js application. Cover unit tests, end-to-end tests, performance checks, environment variables, and Vercel deployment.

output_examples.input: Plan a new analytics dashboard with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Server Components.
output: Recommended project type and routing approach.
A phased setup checklist for TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, layout, and data fetching.
Suggested companion skills for scaffolding, App Router patterns, and UI design.

output_examples.input: Improve forms and validation in an existing React feature.
output: A form workflow using React Hook Form and Zod.
Validation, error handling, submission, and accessibility review steps.
Quality gates for tests, linting, and responsive behavior.

output_examples.input: Prepare my Next.js application for production deployment.
output: A release checklist for build settings, bundle optimization, tests, and performance metrics.
Deployment planning guidance for Vercel preview and production environments.
Review reminders for environment variables and accessibility checks.

best_practices: Use the phase order as a checklist before generating project files.
Confirm framework versions and available companion skills before applying the prompts.
Pair the quality gates with real tests, linting, accessibility checks, and performance measurements.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the workflow as a complete generated application.
Do not skip version checks when using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, or testing tools.
Do not deploy without reviewing environment variables, build settings, and production permissions.

faq.question: Does this skill create files by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and prompt patterns for an AI coding assistant.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it target?
faq.answer: It targets React and Next.js 14+ applications using App Router and Server Components.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it include testing guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers unit testing, component testing, end-to-end testing, and quality gates.

faq.question: Does it cover deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a build and deployment phase focused on Vercel and preview deployments.

faq.question: Is it suitable for existing applications?
faq.answer: Yes. You can apply individual phases to improve components, routing, forms, tests, or deployment readiness.
